title: NEXARA Phase 2B Design Contract — Preference Model & Experience Learning
design_principles: BRAIN_ABOVE_RUNTIME: All learning operates at brain layer, never touches runtime
MEMORY_FOUNDATION: All models read/write through MemoryController interface
EVIDENCE_BACKED: Every preference, pattern, and lesson binds to specific evidence
PERSONAL_SOVEREIGN: Single-owner model — no federated learning, no telemetry
INCREMENTAL_ACTIVATION: Each component independently toggleable via boundary.py check()

PREF-01.name: PreferenceModel
PREF-01.description: Learns and applies user preferences from observed behavior patterns

capabilities.name: record_behavior
capabilities.desc: Observe a user action and derive preference signal

capabilities.name: infer_preference
capabilities.desc: Given a decision context, return ranked preference vector

capabilities.name: update_weights
capabilities.desc: Reinforce or decay preference weights based on outcome feedback

capabilities.name: resolve_conflict
capabilities.desc: When two preferences contradict, apply decay curve to older entry and reinforce newer

capabilities.name: get_profile
capabilities.desc: Return current preference model snapshot for audit

EXP-01.name: ExperienceLearner
EXP-01.description: Records mission outcomes, extracts success/failure patterns, ranks experiences by relevance

capabilities.name: record_mission_outcome
capabilities.desc: Store mission result with full trace for learning

capabilities.name: extract_pattern
capabilities.desc: Given N recorded outcomes, surface common success/failure vectors

capabilities.name: rank_experiences
capabilities.desc: Rank past experiences by similarity to current mission context

capabilities.name: get_lessons
capabilities.desc: Return top-N lessons for a given decision domain

capabilities.name: prune_irrelevant
capabilities.desc: Remove experiences below confidence threshold after decay period

activation_gates.pattern_extraction_auto: BLOCKED — requires EVO-07 R3 capability gate

forbidden: experience patterns modify runtime dispatch logic
model weight export to external systems
